title: Grateful Dead Live at Haight Street on 1968-03-03

ai_review.summary: Historic 1968 Haight‑Street free concert captured on a rough audience tape – the performance is modest and the recording suffers from pitch problems and missing sections.
ai_review.review: The show offers an interesting snapshot of the Dead’s winter ’68 setlist, but listeners should temper expectations: Jerry Garcia is heard on a brief Les Paul/P‑90 stint and the band plays competently given the outdoor, impromptu setting. The audience‑sourced recording is plagued by pitch instability, tape hiss and incomplete tracks, making it more of a historical curiosity than a high‑fidelity listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Both show quality and recording quality are judged as below average; weighted scoring (70 % show, 30 % recording) yields a low‑mid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Pitch fluctuations throughout, tape hiss and modulation hum, missing songs (Tift OO, Dancing in the Streets), and overall unstable speed correction needed.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Standard winter ’68 set performed outdoors; competent but unremarkable playing given the circumstances, mainly of historical interest.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Playing a Les Paul with P‑90 pickups – noted as a short‑lived instrument choice.
